sloka: न हि तद्विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकाङ्क्षिणः ।रिपूणां सदृशं चैतन्न त्वयैतत् स्वनुष्ठितम् ।। ६.१०६.८ ।।
transliteration: na hi tadvidyate karma suhṛdo hitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।ripūṇāṁ sadṛśaṁ caitanna tvayaitat svanuṣṭhitam ।। 6.106.8 ।।

translations.english: What has been done by you is not befitting, this is What an enemy should have done. Being good at heart you have done What is good for enemy.
